subject: Kickoff: ColTran archive colorization
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the colorization product effort for the vision portfolio. Base is our open-source Colorization Transformer: a three-stage stack — autoregressive colorizer, color upsampler, spatial upsampler — pointed at the photo-archive restoration market. The custom-dataset fine-tuning path already exists in the release, which is exactly what archive customers need.

Half goals: (1) fine-tune on two customer-like archival datasets, (2) hit the quality bar — remembering evaluation must be distribution-level (FID), not per-image SSIM/LPIPS, since any single plausible colorization won't match ground truth — and (3) a Shipyard-hosted demo for Launch Review Board in mid-July.

I'd also like a low-cost serving story; the autoregressive stage worries me for latency. Staffing and compute plan by 5/8?

Lucia
